title: PeopleSoft Studio's message channel writer replays App Designer's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/channelWriter.test.ts rebuilds App Designer's captured saves (HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's message channel writer and requires App Designer's rows and counters; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3); it says nothing about releases not captured. docs/MESSAGE_CHANNELS.md lists the cases.

observations.observation: Run of src/test/channelWriter.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 11 top-level tests, all passed.

testResults.name: the window's operations write the rows App Designer wrote
a sweep shows nothing else written
Save As copies the properties and the checked partitions under the new name [chn06]
File > Delete: the rows, PSCHNLDEL at the new CHDM, CHDM and SYS [chn08]
File > Rename re-keys the channel and repoints its references [chn07-rename]
File > Rename re-keys the channel and repoints its references [chn17-rename-refs]
the partition list is App Designer's: shared level-0 fields, then the standard four; none without messages
opening drops stored partitions the window does not list, and says so
Add Partition Field: uppercased, a duplicate ignored, an unchecked one re-checked
the token moves with the version and the partitions
